rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()><thumbnail(292)>... He had indeed come back to this side, after all.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>And, using the battle with <book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()> as cover, he activated the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> that exists in this world.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>He used the resonance energy of <book(14)>Axis<endbook()> to raise the <book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()> at a speed never seen before.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Now the two worlds have formed a connection<thumbnail(293)>, and the two Earths are drawing closer.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>If we simply wait like this, the collapse of the world from planetary collision will come.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>To avoid the worst outcome, we need to shut down the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()><thumbnail(162)>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>By Ensign <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>'s hand, we must shut down the remaining <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> and stop the connection between the two worlds.
rows.notes: 'Ensign Barrel' word order (rank before the color-wrapped name) per precedent 4004453.json, even though the source word order is Barrel-then-rank.

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We have already set course for the Cecilia Islands<thumbnail(294)>, but ahead of us we have detected an immense heat source.
rows.notes: Cecilia Islands provisional spelling per terms_028.json / 4003030.json precedent; no English source exists.

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>It's likely <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>... it seems he has no intention of letting us pass, either.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We will defeat <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> and open a path through to the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>.
<thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Through the battles so far, we have overcome crisis after crisis. And many people have been sacrificed.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>So that everything we have done until now will not be for nothing, we face our final battle.
